checkin.captcha.missing.description: The human-verification widget has not been completed yet.

checkin.continue.action.description: Button of the page shown when the check-in link was opened from another site; it submits the link's token to this site and starts the check-in.

checkin.continue.body.defaultMessage: You opened a check-in link from another site. Tap continue to go on with your check-in.
checkin.continue.body.description: Line under the heading of the page shown when the check-in link was opened from another site. Nothing has been started yet and the page shows nothing about any attendee.

checkin.continue.title.description: Heading of the page shown when the check-in link was opened from another site (a link in a message or an app, for example) and must be confirmed with one tap before the check-in starts.

checkin.flow.error.description: Generic error hint, for a step that reports a failure without a message of its own.

checkin.flow.processing.description: Generic progress hint, for a step that starts work without a message of its own.

checkin.flow.slowResponse.defaultMessage: The server is taking longer than expected to respond. Try again in a moment
checkin.flow.slowResponse.description: A step's request timed out, or the server was too busy to take it. Neutral on purpose: on the day a stall is likelier to be the network than the server, and a timed-out request may still have gone through, so the copy blames neither.

checkin.init.error.notFound.defaultMessage: User not found. Check in again
checkin.init.error.notFound.description: Toast after the entry link named nobody.

checkin.init.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again
checkin.init.error.rateLimited.description: Toast after too many attempts; it clears by itself.

checkin.init.error.unauthorized.defaultMessage: Your session expired. Check in again

checkin.init.error.validation.defaultMessage: {audience, select, participant {Invalid ticket code or QR code. Enter your ticket code below} volunteer {Invalid check-in code or QR code. Enter your check-in code below} other {Invalid ticket code or QR code. Enter your ticket code below}}
checkin.init.error.validation.description: Toast after an entry link or QR was rejected; the person types their code instead. Participants have a ticket code, volunteers a check-in code. Worded per audience; other repeats the participant wording and is only a fallback.

checkin.init.recoverableError.defaultMessage: Something went wrong. Reload the page
checkin.init.recoverableError.description: The check-in page failed to draw but the session is intact, so reloading fixes it.

checkin.init.unknownError.description: Toast after being sent back to check-in for a failure with no specific message.

checkin.lockout.rateLimit.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Restart check-in and complete the verification
checkin.lockout.rateLimit.description: Toast when too many attempts reset the flow to the start.

checkin.preview.toggle.description: Screen-reader label of the button that expands or collapses the summary of whose ticket is being checked in.

checkin.progress.arrival.description: Third step of the progress indicator: confirming arrival at the venue.

checkin.progress.label.description: Accessible name of the three-step progress indicator at the top of check-in.

checkin.progress.ticket.description: First step of the progress indicator: typing the code.

checkin.progress.verification.description: Second step of the progress indicator: confirming the code is the person's own.

checkin.scanner.cameraAccessRequest.description: Shown while the browser asks for camera permission.

checkin.scanner.defaultHint.defaultMessage: Scan the QR code at the entrance to confirm you have arrived
checkin.scanner.defaultHint.description: Hint under the scanner while it waits for the venue's QR code.

checkin.scanner.error.captchaRequired.description: The server now requires human verification before the scan is accepted.

checkin.scanner.error.notFound.defaultMessage: We couldn't read that QR code. Try again or use another one
checkin.scanner.error.notFound.description: The scanned code matched nothing; same wording as a rejected code.

checkin.scanner.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again
checkin.scanner.error.rateLimited.description: Too many scans; it clears by itself.

checkin.scanner.error.validation.defaultMessage: We couldn't read that QR code. Try again or use another one
checkin.scanner.error.validation.description: The scanned code is not the venue's.

checkin.scanner.header.description: Heading of the step where the attendee scans the venue's QR code to confirm they are there.

checkin.scanner.help.defaultMessage: If it does not work, ask a volunteer for help

checkin.scanner.presence.button.defaultMessage: Already checked in with a volunteer? Tap to continue
checkin.scanner.presence.button.description: Secondary button under the scanner's help line. For an attendee whose camera failed and whom a volunteer already marked present on the staff screen; it asks the server whether that happened. Phrased as a question followed by the action.

checkin.scanner.presence.error.description: Any failure checking whether a volunteer confirmed the attendee that has no specific message, such as a network error or too many requests. Same wording as the other steps' generic errors.

checkin.scanner.presence.notYet.defaultMessage: Your check-in has not been confirmed yet. Confirm your arrival with the QR code
checkin.scanner.presence.notYet.description: Shown when the attendee taps the volunteer-confirmation button before a volunteer has marked them present. An expected outcome, not a failure; the button stays disabled for a few seconds afterwards.

checkin.scanner.processing.description: Shown while a scanned code is checked.

checkin.scanner.success.description: Shown when the venue's QR code was accepted.

checkin.scanner.unknownError.defaultMessage: We couldn't read that QR code. Try again or use another one
checkin.scanner.unknownError.description: Any other scan failure; worded like a bad read, since re-scanning is the useful next step.

checkin.success.greeting.description: Greeting on the final card. name is the attendee's first name.

checkin.success.greetingFallback.description: Greeting on the final card when no first name is known.

checkin.success.heading.description: Heading on the final card before the attendee's name is known; replaced by the greeting once it is.

checkin.success.help.defaultMessage: Tap here to open the app
checkin.success.help.description: Link to the pass, for when the automatic move does not happen.

checkin.success.numberLabel.description: Label above the check-in number on the final card.

checkin.success.redirect.description: Shown just before moving on to the pass.

checkin.success.success.description: Status line on the final card.

checkin.ticket.defaultHint.defaultMessage: Enter the code you received on WhatsApp
checkin.ticket.defaultHint.description: Hint under the code field. Codes are sent by WhatsApp.

checkin.ticket.empty.defaultMessage: Enter the code you received on WhatsApp
checkin.ticket.empty.description: The code field was submitted empty.

checkin.ticket.error.captchaRequired.description: The server now requires human verification. Deliberately the same wording as an invalid code; the verification widget appears alongside it.

checkin.ticket.error.checkinNotOpen.description: Check-in has not opened yet for this person's audience.

checkin.ticket.error.notFound.description: The code matches nobody. Deliberately the same wording as a malformed code, so the screen does not reveal which codes exist.

checkin.ticket.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again
checkin.ticket.error.rateLimited.description: Too many code attempts; it clears by itself.

checkin.ticket.error.validation.description: The server rejected the code. Deliberately the same wording as an unknown code, so the screen does not reveal which codes exist.

checkin.ticket.header.description: Heading of the first check-in step, where the code is typed.

checkin.ticket.help.defaultMessage: If you did not receive a code, go to the support desk
checkin.ticket.help.description: Fixed line under the code field's hint, for attendees who never received a code. Sends them to the support desk on site, the only way to get one at the door.

checkin.ticket.inputLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the code field.

checkin.ticket.invalidCode.description: The typed code has the right length but is not a valid code.

checkin.ticket.invalidFormat.description: The typed code is not six characters in a valid shape.

checkin.ticket.processing.defaultMessage: {audience, select, participant {Looking up your ticket...} volunteer {Looking up your registration...} other {Looking up your ticket...}}
checkin.ticket.processing.description: Shown while the code is looked up. Participants have a ticket, volunteers a registration. Worded per audience; other repeats the participant wording and is only a fallback.

checkin.ticket.success.defaultMessage: {audience, select, participant {Your ticket was found!} volunteer {Your registration was found!} other {Your ticket was found!}}
checkin.ticket.success.description: Shown when the code matched. Worded per audience; other repeats the participant wording and is only a fallback.

checkin.ticket.unknownError.description: Any other failure on the code step.

checkin.userPreview.nameLabel.description: Label of the name in the summary of whose ticket is being checked in.

checkin.userPreview.phoneLabel.description: Label of the masked phone number in the summary of whose ticket is being checked in.

checkin.userPreview.ticketLabel.description: Label of the code in the summary of whose ticket is being checked in.

checkin.verification.backButton.description: Returns from the confirmation step to the code step.

checkin.verification.defaultHint.defaultMessage: Enter the last 4 digits of your phone number
checkin.verification.defaultHint.description: Hint under the phone-digits field; also shown again when the digits are incomplete.

checkin.verification.error.captchaRequir.description: The server now requires human verification before the digits are checked.

checkin.verification.error.notFound.description: The phone digits match nothing. Same wording as a rejected entry, so the screen reveals nothing about the record.

checkin.verification.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again
checkin.verification.error.rateLimited.description: Too many digit attempts; it clears by itself.

checkin.verification.header.defaultMessage: {audience, select, participant {Confirm your identity} volunteer {Confirm your identity} other {Confirm your identity}}
checkin.verification.header.description: Heading of the step that confirms the code belongs to the person holding the phone. Worded per audience; other repeats the participant wording and is only a fallback.

checkin.verification.inputLabel.defaultMessage: Last 4 digits of your phone number
checkin.verification.inputLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the phone-digits field.

checkin.verification.processing.description: Shown while the phone digits are checked.

checkin.verification.success.description: Shown when the phone digits matched.

checkin.verification.unknownError.defaultMessage: Something went wrong. Try again. If the error persists, go to the support desk
checkin.verification.unknownError.description: Any other failure on the confirmation step.
